7.11.2.3 Access DTCs and Status Information
The following chapter defines the APIs, which shall be used to access the number of DTCs, and DTCs matching specific filter criteria and the associated status information.
[SWS_Dem_00231] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04201
⌈The API Dem_GetTranslationType shall return the translation format of the DemEventMemorySet configured in DemTypeOfDTCSupported.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00060] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈The function Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask shall set the out parameter DTCStatusMask to the value configured in DemDtcStatusAvailabilityMask of the DemEventMemorySet for the assigned client ID.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01342] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈If the function Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask is called with a DTCOrigin different to DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PRIMARY_MEMORY or DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_USERDEFINED_MEMORY_<Name>, the Dem shall report the development error DEM_E_PARAM_DATA.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01181] ⌈The Dem module shall be able to return the DTC severity availability mask (refer to Dem_GetDTCSeverityAvailabilityMask) in accordance to ISO 14229-1 [1].⌋
[SWS_Dem_01182]
⌈The function Dem_GetDTCSeverityAvailabilityMask shall calculate the DTC severity availability mask in accordance to ISO 14229-1 [1] from the severity configuration of each supported DTC.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00657] ⌈The Dem module shall mask all DTC status bytes (API parameters DTCStatus) provided to the Dcm with the DTC status availability mask (by performing a bit-wise AND operation).⌋
[SWS_Dem_00059] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈The function Dem_GetStatusOfDTC shall copy the status of the selected DTC to the parameter DTCStatus. The DTCStatus format is according to ISO-14229-1[2].⌋
[SWS_Dem_01259] ⌈If the API Dem_GetStatusOfDTC is called on a selected DTC that does not exist in the selected format or if the selected DTC is a group of DTC or no DTC was selected, the Dem shall return DEM_WRONG_DTC.⌋
